name: guards
description: Repo guardrails as scripts behind a gate — one script per check with a stable id and exit codes 0 / 1 / 2 meaning pass, findings, refused; .claude/guards.json names the enabled checks and each one's rung, warn or block; a git pre-commit adapter judges the index and is inert in a repo with no config. Checks: anchors (every in-repo section link resolves to an explicit <a id> and every relative link target exists), war-stories (narrative provenance in process docs), plan-sweeps (every backticked rg in a plan runs, without a shell; a malformed one is a finding, and so is a count stated beside it that the sweep does not find), referents (a backticked script, /command, or env knob nothing in the repo answers to), retro-log and review-ledger (the threads plugin's log and ledger grammars). Rung as config is the enforcement ladder made add-only.
